title: Seven shuffles
why: Mathematicians proved a 52-card deck needs about seven riffle shuffles to be properly mixed.

title: Tarot card games
why: Tarot decks were invented for trick-taking games, and they're still played that way across Europe.

title: Hanafuda
why: Japanese flower cards with no numbers at all: twelve months, four cards each. Nintendo started out printing them.

title: Libratus
why: The poker AI that beat top professionals at no-limit hold'em by working out its strategy instead of copying humans.

title: Playing card suits
why: Hearts and spades are just one family. Italian, Spanish, German and Swiss decks use cups, coins, acorns and bells.
